independence.note: Continued only from own LATEST checkpoint and public primary sources.

checked_sources.source: Sreenivas Gollapudi, Kostas Kollias, Kamesh Munagala, Ali Sinop, Efficient Online Conformal Selection with Limited Feedback, arXiv:2605.14953v4, 2026
checked_sources.result: Primary-verified a direct combination of pathwise/adversarial long-run validity and stochastic cost efficiency under highly restricted bandit feedback. The algorithm applies an unprojected Adaptive Conformal Inference update to a primal or dual control parameter and stabilizes it via explicit boundary actions rather than projections. The informal meta-theorem gives target-tracking error O(1/sqrt(T)) and sublinear efficiency regret. The introduction reports O(sqrt(n T log(nT))) efficiency regret for the finite-arm dual-control construction; model-specific discretized/scoring instantiations have weaker rates such as ~O(T^(2/3)) or ~O(T^(3/4)), so the rate must be attached to the exact model. Crucially, projected dual updates break the telescoping identity needed for adversarial conformal validity.

checked_sources.source: Yu Gui, Ying Jin, Yash Nair, Zhimei Ren, ACS: An interactive framework for conformal selection, arXiv:2507.15825, 2025
checked_sources.result: Primary-verified an adaptive, interactive conformal-selection framework designed for human-in-the-loop analysis. ACS permits partial data reuse, on-the-fly model/selection updates, diversified selection, and incorporation of newly labeled data while retaining rigorous FDR control by restricting what information is exposed to each adaptive decision. The abstract reports extensive synthetic and real-data demonstrations in LLM deployment and drug discovery, but exact numerical power gains were not extracted in this run and are not claimed.

checked_sources.source: Kapilan Balagopalan, Ngo Tuan Nguyen, Yao Zhao, Kwang-Sung Jun, Fixing the Loose Brake: Exponential-Tailed Stopping Time in Best Arm Identification, ICML/PMLR 2025
checked_sources.result: Primary-verified that common fixed-confidence best-arm algorithms with only high-probability stopping guarantees can have a positive-probability never-stopping event. The paper gives two remedies with exponential-tailed stopping times: a Sequential-Halving-plus-doubling construction and a meta-algorithm that wraps any fixed-confidence algorithm possessing a high-probability stopping guarantee. This improves on prior polynomial-tail stopping behavior. The public abstract establishes the tail-class improvement and nontermination pathology; no fabricated numeric runtime ratio is attached.

candidates_new.mechanism: For adaptive sequential admission under limited feedback, keep the cumulative error/constraint controller unprojected so its accounting identity remains exact. Stabilize the controller through explicit real boundary actions (for example, a guaranteed-success but costly fallback) instead of clipping the internal dual/primal state. This can preserve pathwise validity while still optimizing resource cost stochastically.
candidates_new.quantitative_evidence: The paper's informal meta-theorem gives adversarial target-tracking error O(1/sqrt(T)) with sublinear efficiency regret. Its finite-arm dual-controller introduction states O(sqrt(n T log(nT))) efficiency regret, while specific model instantiations in the comparison table have ~O(T^(2/3)) or ~O(T^(3/4)); rates are model-dependent and should not be collapsed.
candidates_new.operational_observable: Track cumulative success/validity debt, controller state, boundary-action frequency and cost, average success target error, realized resource cost, stochastic efficiency regret proxy, and whether any projection/clipping occurred. Boundary actions should be explicit decisions recorded in the trace.
candidates_new.scope: Online conformal subset/threshold selection under bandit-style feedback; pathwise long-run validity for arbitrary sequences and stochastic efficiency against an optimal stochastic benchmark under the paper's model assumptions.
candidates_new.failure_conditions: This is not a per-step target-utility/no-negative-transfer guarantee. Efficiency comparison assumes stochastic/i.i.d. structure and model-specific Lipschitz/non-flatness conditions in some instantiations. Boundary fallback can be intentionally suboptimal and costly. Projecting or clipping the controller can destroy the validity proof.
candidates_new.transfer_hypothesis: Autonomous research admission can maintain an exact debt ledger for missed validity/safety targets, allowing aggressive low-cost choices when debt is low and invoking an explicit conservative fallback when debt grows, rather than silently clipping accumulated evidence or risk debt.
candidates_new.confidence: high for source-domain mechanism; medium-high for research-loop transfer

candidates_new.mechanism: Permit adaptive exploration and partial data reuse while controlling which information is available to each certification/selection decision. The information-access rule acts as a statistical firewall: exploratory analysis can evolve, but the selection step only consumes information allowed by the validity protocol.
candidates_new.quantitative_evidence: The source establishes rigorous FDR control for its adaptive conformal-selection framework and reports extensive simulations plus LLM/drug-discovery applications; exact effect-size numbers were not extracted here and are deliberately not inferred from figures.
candidates_new.operational_observable: Record which evidence each adaptive decision was allowed to see, data portions reused, model/selection updates, selection set, FDR/false-selection statistics, and any information-flow violations. Keep exploratory state separate from certification state.
candidates_new.scope: Interactive adaptive conformal selection under the ACS information-control protocol. This is error-rate control for selection, not a general guarantee on downstream scientific utility or regret.
candidates_new.failure_conditions: If exploratory information leaks into the certification step outside the permitted protocol, FDR guarantees can fail. The guarantee does not imply that the adaptively selected candidate is globally optimal or useful. Exact power gains are dataset/procedure dependent.
candidates_new.transfer_hypothesis: A research system can reduce context contamination by separating a rich exploratory workspace from a narrow certification view whose permitted evidence is mechanically controlled, enabling iterative hypothesis updates without invalidating downstream selection statistics.
candidates_new.confidence: high for source-domain validity structure; medium for transfer

candidates_new.mechanism: Treat nontermination probability and stopping-time tails as first-class algorithm properties. Wrap a fixed-confidence search/selection algorithm with a restart/doubling-style meta-procedure so that completion time has an exponential tail rather than merely a high-probability bound that can hide a never-stopping event.
candidates_new.quantitative_evidence: The paper proves that some popular fixed-confidence algorithms can fail to stop with positive probability despite standard high-probability guarantees, and constructs algorithms with exponential-tailed stopping times, improving on prior polynomial-tail behavior. No numeric speedup ratio is claimed from the abstract-level evidence used here.
candidates_new.operational_observable: Measure full stopping-time distribution, timeout/restart counts, probability mass beyond each runtime multiple, never-stop incidents, correctness after wrapping, and added sample/work overhead. Do not summarize liveness with mean runtime alone.
candidates_new.scope: Fixed-confidence best-arm identification; one construction uses Sequential Halving plus doubling and another is a generic wrapper for algorithms with a high-probability stopping guarantee.
candidates_new.failure_conditions: An exponential-tail wrapper can add repeated-work overhead and does not fix a wrong objective, biased evaluator, or invalid correctness guarantee. Translation to heterogeneous research tasks requires a meaningful confidence/stopping contract and restartable state.
candidates_new.transfer_hypothesis: Long-running autonomous research should explicitly control the tail of unit completion time, using restart/escalation wrappers around probabilistic search units rather than assuming a high-probability progress guarantee prevents pathological stalls.
candidates_new.confidence: high for liveness principle; medium for autonomous-research transfer

evidence_updates.update: r16 closes part of the prior frontier: a single primary method now combines adversarial/pathwise validity under adaptive sequential feedback with a distinct resource-efficiency objective and explicit sublinear stochastic regret. It is closer to a direct validity+utility controller than merely composing e-process and utility safeguards, but its utility benchmark is stochastic cost efficiency rather than a target-only no-negative-transfer fallback.

ACS/r17 supplies an information-flow pattern for repeated adaptive selection and partial data reuse, complementing r15's one-shot/fresh-candidate oracle-weight certification. No source in this run proves the exact composition of adaptive repeated proposals, proposal-shift correction, and finite-sample target-utility fallback.

deferred_or_negative_evidence.lead: Standard projected constrained-bandit dual updates can simply be combined with ACI while retaining adversarial conformal validity.
deferred_or_negative_evidence.evidence: Gollapudi et al. explicitly show that projection/clipping breaks the exact telescoping accounting used for pathwise validity; they replace projection with boundary actions.
deferred_or_negative_evidence.reason: Do not stabilize a validity-debt controller by silently forgetting debt.

deferred_or_negative_evidence.lead: A high-probability stopping-time bound is enough evidence that a search unit will eventually stop.
deferred_or_negative_evidence.evidence: Balagopalan et al. prove positive-probability never-stopping can occur for popular fixed-confidence BAI algorithms despite common high-probability analyses.
deferred_or_negative_evidence.reason: Liveness audits should examine stopping-time tails/nontermination, not only expectation or one high-probability bound.

deferred_or_negative_evidence.lead: Adaptive conformal/FDR validity automatically certifies downstream scientific utility.
deferred_or_negative_evidence.evidence: ACS controls false selections under its information protocol; it does not establish target regret or global optimization quality.
deferred_or_negative_evidence.reason: Keep statistical selection validity separate from utility and decision relevance.

frontier: Find a primary sequential-transfer or candidate-admission method that combines time-uniform/adversarial validity with an explicit target-only utility or regret fallback, not merely stochastic cost efficiency.

Find an online repeated-round extension of proposal-shift conformal candidate certification with estimated (not oracle) density ratios and explicit finite-sample guarantees after adaptive prior experiments.

Extract exact empirical stopping-time tail/overhead tradeoffs from exponential-tail best-arm wrappers and test whether similar restart/doubling logic exists for asynchronous distributed optimization/search.
Find finite-budget covariance-aware ranking/selection under genuinely heavy-tailed paired/common-random-number observations with robust estimators and exact PCS/sample-count guarantees.
Quantify ACS information-firewall cost: how much selection power is lost or gained relative to unrestricted adaptive analysis and nonadaptive conformal selection on the same tasks.

actions_taken_instead_of_stopping: Followed the exact prior frontier into a 2026 primary method combining pathwise validity and resource-efficiency regret under fully bandit feedback.
Extended repeated adaptive selection into ACS and isolated the information-control principle from utility claims.
Opened a separate OR/bandit liveness branch and found a formal positive-probability nontermination pathology plus exponential-tail wrapper remedy.
Kept a nonempty frontier because no source yet gives the exact desired time-uniform target-only no-negative-transfer fallback under repeated adaptive proposal shift.

exact_next_action: Prioritize primary work on sequential transfer/admission with both anytime/pathwise validity and an explicit target-only regret or utility fallback. Search safe online transfer/conformal decision rules and conservative bandit baselines. In parallel, extract theorem/experiment details for exponential-tail stopping wrappers and robust heavy-tailed covariance-aware best-arm selection if the direct transfer frontier remains empty.
